description: Least-privilege capability for the main WebView. It is navigated to the loopback sidecar, whose HTML/JS may include model-generated content, so it receives only core window commands, the text-zoom command, the download save/open commands, the release-update check and the sign-in page's local password reset (which asks for a native confirmation) the suite actually calls. All wizard, Drive, sync, tray and destructive commands stay on the local-only wizard capability (#2688).
